notes.query_counting: Query count tracked via Prisma $use middleware which intercepts every operation before execution.
notes.A3: query_count_median: 101 — Prisma dataloader batches user lookups but in sequential loop each findUnique triggers a separate query.
notes.A4: query_count_median: 1 — include: { user: true } resolves via single JOIN query.
notes.B1: query_count_median: 1 — nested include across 3 levels in single query.
notes.B3: query_count_median: 1 — Prisma resolves many-to-many via explicit ProductTag junction model with JOIN.
notes.C2: Uses $executeRaw with UPDATE FROM subquery, LIMIT 1000. Prisma updateMany does not support LIMIT. See methodology/c2_limit_analysis.json.
notes.D1: query_count_median: 4 — 1 SELECT products + 1 INSERT order (nested write) + 1 deleteMany items + 1 delete order.

A1.description: Simple SELECT by primary key via findUnique()

A2.description: Filtered list with ORDER BY and LIMIT via findMany()

A3.description: N+1 diagnostic — 100 orders, sequential findUnique per user (intentional)

A4.description: Eager loading via include: { user: true } — single query

B1.description: Deep eager load via nested include — Order → Items → Product → Category in single query

B2.description: Aggregate via findMany with _count — categories with product count

B3.description: Many-to-many via ProductTag junction model with include: { category: true }

C1.description: Bulk insert — 10,000 products in chunks of 500 via createMany()

C2.description: Bulk update — $executeRaw UPDATE FROM subquery, LIMIT 1000 rows (see methodology/c2_limit_analysis.json)

D1.description: Unit of Work — nested create with items in single transaction, 4 queries total
